systems.tiers: Online portal launched in 2024; first service is the criminal record request (anthropometric sheet), with identity card appointments and police recruitment registration added; residency certificates and card renewal expected next

note: The DGSN's 2024 end-of-year report as carried by Barlamane: the identity card programme, identity verification platforms and the E-Police portal, with over 1.5 million criminal records issued in the year. All of it is identity or a public portal. Nothing on how a station records a report or a case.
